brief: Top Pick: Graphify (graphify-labs/graphify) is the breakout opportunity; turning codebases into queryable knowledge graphs is the missing link for high-context AI coding agents.
The 'Agentic OS' layer is maturing: Combine Graphify with stablyai/orca to build a sophisticated, context-aware dev environment that orchestrates multiple coding agents.
Immediate edge: Use firecrawl for high-fidelity data ingestion to feed these knowledge graphs, creating a defensible moat in specialized domain-specific coding assistants.
Timing: With the shift from simple LLM wrappers to multi-agent systems, infrastructure for memory and orchestration is the current high-value bottleneck.
